subtitle.text: Riley: Ben! Psst!
Ben: Riley! Shh!
Riley: But I have to tell you something!
Ben: What?
Riley: It's about my dog Snooks.
Ben: Snooks is all you ever talk about.
Riley: But this is big news.
I taught Snooks a new trick!
Mrs. Bell: Riley and Ben, no talking please!
Riley: I'm sorry, Mrs. Bell.
I just wanted to tell Ben about Snooks.
Mrs. Bell: What does that have to do with school?
Riley: Well . . . I'm teaching Snooks.
Teaching him tricks!
Mrs. Bell: That's nice. But you and Ben broke the no-talking rule.
Mrs. Bell: That means no recess today!
Riley: I'm sorry, Ben.
I got you into trouble.
Ben: Again! What did you teach Snooks anyway?
Riley: I taught him how to roll over!
Ben: Wow! I wish I could teach my turtle, Speedy, a trick.
Riley: Maybe I could help you.
Riley: That was a pretty fun recess.
Ben: Yeah! Too bad we can't talk about our pets all day.
Riley: And teach them tricks together.
Riley: I have an idea!
There's no time for our pets during school.
Riley: So let's meet with our pets after school.
Ben: What?
Riley: Let's form a club—a pet lovers club!
Riley: We're ready for our first meeting of the Pet Lovers Club.
Ben: Those snacks look good!
Riley: Hey, those are dog treats!
Ben: Ugh. Oops.
Mrs. Summers: Here are your treats!
Riley: Snooks, are you ready for the first meeting?
Snooks: Ar-ooo!
Ben: Someone's here.
Riley: Oh, hi, Skyler. Come in.
Skyler: I saw your poster for the Pet Lovers Club.
I'm so excited!
Chatter: Bad boy, brush your teeth!
Skyler: Meet Chatter, my parrot.
Chatter: Squawk! Did you do your homework?
Ben: He sounds just like my mom!
Theo: Hi. Is this the Pet Lovers Club?
Riley: Yes, come in.
Theo: My name is Theo.
I love pets.
Theo: This is my hamster, Whiskers, and this frog is—
Theo: Frankie, come back!
Ben: Ha-ha! He's a good jumper.
Theo: I'm trying to teach him better manners.
Sarah: Can I come in?
Skyler: This is Sarah.
She lives in the yellow house on the corner.
Ben: This is Speedy.
Where's your pet, Sarah?
Sarah: I, um, my pet is a secret.
Riley: A secret?
Sarah: Yes. A really big secret.
Theo: But you can't keep your pet a secret.
Ben: We're going to teach our pets tricks.
Riley: And take them places!
Sarah: The truth is—I don't have a pet!
Chatter: Uh-oh!
Sarah: I want a real kitten.
But all I have is Mittens!
Theo: What happened to his ears?
Sarah: The dog next door chewed them off.
Chatter: Oh, my, what a shame!
Sarah: Can I please be in the Pet Lovers Club?
Sarah: I might get a real kitten one day.
Riley: Of course you can, Sarah.
Riley: The Pet Lovers Club will meet at my house.
Riley: We can plan tricks and trips for our pets.
Skyler: And guess what?
There's going to be a pet talent show soon!
Theo: It's in the park on Saturday.
Theo: I heard the winner gets five free tickets to the zoo.
Sarah: The big zoo in New York City?
Riley: Yes. The talent show can be our first project!
Ben: I can't wait to teach Speedy his first trick.
Theo: My hamster, Whiskers, can run in circles.
Riley: I'm going to teach Snooks to shake hands.
Snooks: Ar-ooo!
Skyler: Maybe I can teach Chatter to sing a song.
Chatter: Eat your spinach!
Ben: Look! I got Speedy to roll over!
Sarah: What a great trick.
Chatter: Uh-oh.
Ben: Uh-oh is right.
He can't roll back over.
Sarah: Speedy is stuck!
Skyler: You'd better think of a different trick, Ben.
Riley: One of our pets just has to win on Saturday.
Theo: New York City, here we come!
Ben: Look at all these pets!
Theo: The judges look serious.
Whiskers is nervous!
Skyler: Come on, let's get in line.
Chatter: Twinkle, twinkle, little star!
Skyler: Shh. Not yet, Chatter!
Sarah: Look, that cat jumped through a hoop.
Theo: I hope it doesn’t win first prize.
Ben: The only trick Speedy knows is how to stand still.
Riley: Don't worry. Snooks will win.
Then we can all go to the zoo!
Theo: You're next, Skyler!
Judge 1: What trick will your parrot do?
Skyler: Chatter will sing "Twinkle, Twinkle Little Star."
Skyler: Okay, Chatter, sing!
Chatter: Squawk! Clean up that mess!
Judge 2: Thank you. Next, please!
Skyler: Oh no. Chatter didn't do very well.
Ben: Theo, it's your turn.
Judge 1: What trick will your hamster perform?
Theo: Whiskers will run around in circles.
Go, Whiskers, run fast!
Theo: No, Whiskers. Come back here!
Judge 3: Ha-ha! That tickles!
Theo: I'm sorry. Whiskers wasn't supposed to run away.
But it was funny.
Judge 1: Next, please!
Ben: Riley, it's Snooks' turn.
He has to win.
Theo: Yeah, it’s our last chance to go to the zoo!
Riley: Snooks, it's all up to you now.
Snooks: Ar-ooo!
Riley: Okay, Snooks. This is our chance to win the pet talent show!
Riley: Let's go shake hands with the judges now.
Ben: Good luck!
Judge 1: What trick will your dog perform, young lady?
Riley: Snooks is going to—
Snooks: Ar-ooooooooooooooooooooooooooo!
Judge 1: Ouch. That hurt my ears.
Judge 2: Wow. That was the longest howl I ever heard.
Judge 3: Attention, please, pet owners!
Judge 3: We will announce the contest winner in five minutes!
Riley: Snooks, you were supposed to shake hands!
Chatter: Uh-oh, bad boy!
Theo: I guess the Pet Lovers Club won't be going to the zoo.
Sarah: I really wanted to go to the zoo!
Theo: Maybe Whiskers will win.
He made a judge laugh.
Chatter: Ha-ha! Ha-ha!
Ben: Shh. They're about to announce the winner.
Judge 1: Thank you all for coming.
We've seen many wonderful tricks today.
Judge 2: There was one trick that was the best.
Judge 3: It was an amazing trick.
Judge 1: The winner of today's contest is . . .
Snooks: Ar-ooooooooooooooooooooooooooo!
Judge 1: Snooks for the longest howl in the whole world!
Riley: Snooks won!
Theo: The Pet Lovers Club is going to the zoo!
Sarah: Thank you, Snooks.
Skyler: Look, Riley. Now Snooks wants to shake hands!
Riley: Good job, Snooks!
We love you.
Ben: I can't believe the Pet Lovers Club is going to the zoo!
Riley: Poor Snooks couldn't come.
Dogs aren't allowed at the zoo.
Riley: But I'll take some pictures for him.
Sarah: Are we there yet?
Mrs. Summers: Almost! We're going into the tunnel.
Sarah: I don't like tunnels.
Ben: Close your eyes.
Chatter: Close your eyes, big surprise!
Riley: We're here!
Chatter: Go home! Do your homework!
Theo: No way, Chatter.
This is super exciting!
Mrs. Summers: Everyone stay together.
Mrs. Summers: We're going downstairs to the subway train.
Riley: The subway speeds under the city.
Ben: It goes right to the zoo!
Riley: There's so much to see.
Where do we start?
Sarah: Mittens wants to look at the big cats.
Ben: Speedy wants to see the crocodile.
Theo: Whiskers is afraid of crocodiles.
Mrs. Summers: The crocodile is in Reptile Ranch.
Riley: Look, it's right over there.
Ben: Let's go inside.
Theo: I want to see the tomato frog.
Sarah: What's a tomato frog?
Ben: There's one. See?
It puffs up like a tomato.
Riley: Then other animals won't eat it.
Theo: I wouldn't eat it either.
Skyler: There's the giant crocodile.
Sarah: Its jaws are wide open!
Theo: Whiskers is so scared, he's shaking!
Riley: If Snooks were here, he'd be howling like crazy!
Riley: Reptile Ranch was fun, but that crocodile was scary!
Skyler: Chatter wants to go to the Parrot Palace.
Chatter: Squawk! Parrot Palace, oh boy!
Ben: Chatter is excited about seeing all the parrots.
Chatter: Squawk! One, two, three, parrots!
Theo: I bet we'll see more than three!
Mrs. Summers: Here we are at the Parrot Palace.
Theo: It says they have over one thousand parrots!
Skyler: Wow! Did you hear that, Chatter?
Sarah: Look, there's a parrot who looks just like Chatter.
Zoo Parrot: Squawk! Hello, parrot!
Chatter: Hello. Good-bye!
Wipe your feet!
Riley: Chatter and that parrot look like twins.
Theo: Here comes the man who feeds the birds.
Skyler: Oh no! Chatter, come back!
Ben: Chatter flew into the parrot cage!
Zoo Parrot: Hello, hello!
Chatter: Hello. Good-bye.
See you later.
Skyler: That must be Chatter!
Ben: Skyler, how can you tell which parrot is Chatter?
Skyler: I know my own parrot . . .
Wait, do I know my parrot?
Skyler: They look so much alike.
Sarah: They sound so much alike too.
Mrs. Summers: Uh-oh, this is trouble.
Chatter: Double trouble.
Zoo Parrot: Uh-oh. Come back tomorrow!
Skyler: I don't want Chatter tomorrow.
I want him right now!
Riley: But Skyler, you don't know which bird is Chatter.
Theo: You can't take the wrong bird.
Skyler: I know. But I can't go home without him!
Skyler: I want my parrot back!
Riley: Don't worry. We'll find a way to get Chatter back.
Ben: There's the zookeeper.
Maybe he can help us.
Skyler: Sir, please help us!
My parrot flew into the cage!
Theo: And now we can't tell which one is hers.
Ben: And which one is the zoo's!
Zookeeper: Wait. You mean one of those parrots is yours?
Skyler: Yes, and I want my parrot right now!
Zookeeper: Try calling him.
Maybe he'll fly over to you.
Skyler: Here, Chatter!
Chatter: Here, Chatter. Ha-ha. Ha-ha.
Skyler: See, that's Chatter!
Zoo parrot: Here, Chatter. Ha-ha. Ha-ha.
Skyler: Maybe it's not Chatter!
I'm so confused!
Skyler: What am I going to do?
I can't go home without Chatter.
Chatter: Go home! Do your homework!
Skyler: Chatter! It is you!
Zookeeper: Are you sure that's your bird?
Skyler: Yes. Only Chatter would tell me to do my homework!
Zookeeper: Okay. I'll unlock the cage and get your bird.
Skyler: Oh, Chatter, I'm so glad to have you back!
Chatter: Wipe your feet!
Time to eat!
Mrs. Summers: It is time to eat.
Riley: I'm really hungry!
Sarah: I am too.
Mrs. Summers: Let's go have lunch!
Ben: That was fun.
I'm glad the Pet Lovers Club went to the zoo.
Chatter: Squawk. Me too!
Riley: That was very fun.
But I can't wait to see Snooks!
Miss Keen: Class, today I have a special surprise.
Miss Keen: Can anyone guess what it is?
Jason: I know! We're going to have a pizza party!
Miss Keen: No, that's not the surprise.
I'll give you a hint.
Miss Keen: It's something really exciting!
Theo: We don't have to come to school tomorrow!
Miss Keen: No. Guess again!
Alexia: We're going to make a pie for Thanksgiving?
Miss Keen: That's not it either.
One more guess!
Skyler: If it's really exciting, it has to do with pets.
Miss Keen: That's right, Skyler!
We're going to have a Paint-Your-Pet Day!
Skyler: What? Paint-Your-Pet Day?
But Chatter is perfect just the way he is.
Skyler: I don't want to paint him a different color.
Miss Keen: We're not going to put paint on our pets.
Miss Keen: We're going to paint pictures of them.
Skyler: Oh.
Theo: Uh-oh.
Miss Keen: The student who paints the best picture wins a prize!
Kids: Yeah! Cool. Oh boy!
Miss Keen: Our principal, Mr. Peabody, will judge the paintings.
Skyler: What's the prize? Money?
Miss Keen: It's not money.
The winner will be on the TV show "Pet Parade."
Theo: Wow. One of our pets could be a TV star!
Theo: I'm worried about Paint-Your-Pet Day.
Riley: Why are you worried, Theo?
Theo: I want Frankie to be on TV.
Skyler: I don't care if Chatter is on TV.
I like him the way he is.
Theo: I really want Frankie to win.
But I'm not a good painter.
Ben: My mom says we can't all be good at everything.
Riley: Right. Theo is good at making people laugh.
Ben: Miss Keen is good at thinking up fun ideas.
Skyler: Chatter is good at chatting.
Riley: Here comes Snooks.
He's good at running!
Snooks: Ar-ooo!
Ben: And howling.
Riley: Don't forget. The Pet Lovers Club meets today!
Kids: We'll be over soon! Bye!
Mrs. Summers: You'll never guess what happened!
Riley: What?
Mrs. Summers: I made brownies for the Pet Lovers Club.
And I burned them!
Mrs. Summers: I'm just not good at baking.
Riley: Don't worry, Mom.
They look okay.
Ben: They taste okay too, Mrs. Summers.
Sarah: Yeah. They are really good!
Mrs. Summers: Thank you. I wish I was a better baker.
Mrs. Summers: Then I could bake better snacks for the club.
Theo: I wish I was good at painting.
But everything I paint looks terrible!
Ben: Why don't you take painting lessons?
Theo: There's no time.
Paint-Your-Pet Day is tomorrow!
Skyler: Maybe you'll paint a funny picture.
Sarah: And make people laugh.
Theo: I don't want to make people laugh.
I want Frankie to be a TV star!
Skyler: Theo, why don't you practice painting Frankie?
Chatter: Hurry up! You'll be late for school.
Theo: I don't really want to go to school, Chatter.
I'm not a good painter.
Riley: Here's some paper, a brush, and paints.
Ben: I'll hold Frankie while you practice.
Frankie: Ribbit. Ribbit.
Theo: Okay.
I'm done.
Ben: That's Frankie?
Skyler: It kind of looks like a fish.
Sarah: Or a cloud.
Theo: I told you.
I can't paint!
Theo: What am I going to do?
Riley: Just do your best.
That's what my mom always says.
Frankie: Ribbit. Ribbit.
Miss Keen: Okay, it's time to paint your pet.
Please work quietly.
Chatter: Shh. Quiet time!
Skyler: Remember, Theo, just do your best!
Miss Keen: Mr. Peabody will be here later.
He will judge your paintings.
Alexia: I hope Spooky gets to be a TV star.
Skyler: Theo, let me see your painting.
Theo: Promise you won't laugh?
Skyler: I promise.
Theo: Here it is.
Skyler: It's good . . . I mean it's a good painting of something.
Skyler: I just don't know what.
Jason: It looks like a squished worm.
Theo: I'll never be able to paint.
And Frankie will never be a TV star!
Miss Keen: Class, get ready.
Mr. Peabody will be here soon.
Miss Keen: He'll choose the winner!
Theo: I want to throw my painting away.
Skyler: Don't do that, Theo.
Jason: It doesn't really look like a squished worm.
Theo: Come on, Frankie.
Get back in my pocket.
We tried our best.
Skyler: Theo, watch out!
Theo: Frankie, stop!
Skyler: Frankie is jumping on your painting.
Theo: He got red footprints all over it!
Frankie, your feet are all red.
Skyler: You really did paint your pet, Theo!
Miss Keen: Class, quiet! Here comes Mr. Peabody.
Miss Keen: Please place your paintings on the board.
Mr. Peabody: Excellent work, everyone!
Mr. Peabody: It won't be easy to choose the best picture.
Miss Keen: The students have been working very hard.
Mr. Peabody: Who painted this picture?
Skyler: That's Theo's.
Mr. Peabody: It has frog footprints on it. How interesting!
Miss Keen: We have some good painters in our class.
Mr. Peabody: Yes, you do!
And I think I've found a first-place winner.
Mr. Peabody: This painting wins first prize!
Miss Keen: Congratulations, Theo!
Theo: Guess what? Frankie is going to be on TV!
Skyler: Frankie was funny today!
He jumped into the red paint.
Sarah: He's very good at jumping.
Ben: I wish Speedy could jump.
Riley: Speedy is good at hiding in his shell.
Sarah: Everyone is good at something.
Riley: You know what the Pet Lovers Club is good at?
Ben: What?
Riley: Having fun!
Skyler: I can't believe it's almost Christmas.
Chatter: Merry Christmas! Happy New Year!
Theo: I have a surprise.
I taught Whiskers a trick.
Riley: Wow. That's amazing!
Ben: I have a surprise too.
Riley: What is it?
Ben: The Pet Lovers Club has a job.
A snake-sitting job!
Sarah: You mean we have to sit on a snake?
Theo: No. Ben means we have a job taking care of a snake.
Ben: That's right!
Riley: Whose snake is it?
Ben: It's Johnny Lee's snake, Sammy.
Johnny lives next door to me.
Ben: His family is going away for Christmas.
Ben: We have to feed Sammy every day for five days.
Theo: Snake-sitting sounds fun!
Ben: Yep. And you'll like Sammy.
He's very friendly.
Theo: This is my big sister Kelli.
My mom said she had to come along.
Kids: Hi, Kelli.
Sarah: Are you baby-sitting us?
Kelli: Well, kind of.
But don't let that snake get near me!
Theo: He won't get near you.
Unless he gets out!
Kelli: He'd better not, or I'm telling Mom!
Theo: Don't worry. I'm just kidding.
Ben: This is where Sammy lives.
I'm going to show him to Speedy.
Sarah: Speedy wants to run away!
Riley: Maybe Speedy doesn't like snakes.
Kelli: He's not the only one.
Skyler: What does Sammy like to eat?
Ben: Snake food from the pet store.
Theo: I bet it has worms in it!
Sarah: I'm glad I don't have to eat worms.
Skyler: Look, Sammy's tongue came out.
Theo: Maybe he's hungry!
Riley: Taking care of a snake is fun!
Snooks: Woof! Woof!
Theo: Look, Snooks is jealous!
Riley: He wants all the attention.
Sarah: Can I hold Sammy now?
Skyler: I'm next!
Theo: I'm after Skyler.
Theo: Kelli, do you want to hold Sammy?
Kelli: Get that thing out of here!
Sarah: I think he's cute.
I wish my mom would let me get a snake.
Ben: It's time to feed Sammy.
I'll get the snake food.
Sarah: Snake food! Yuck!
Theo: Sammy loves it.
Skyler: He's very hungry.
Ben: Don't gobble, Sammy.
You'll get a stomachache.
Skyler: Hey, look at Johnny's fish aquarium!
Riley: My fish, Goldie and Goofy, would love an aquarium.
Skyler: Maybe we can save money from pet-sitting jobs.
Theo: And buy toys and treats for our pets!
Sarah: I could buy a new collar for Mittens.
Theo: I could build Frankie a frog house.
Ben: Sammy is finished eating now.
Riley: The food made a bump in his stomach.
Sarah: Does Sammy want dessert?
Ben: I don't think snakes eat dessert.
Ben: Good-bye, Sammy.
Sarah: We'll see you tomorrow.
Theo: Wait! Something is wrong!
Riley: What's the matter, Theo?
Theo: It's my hamster, Whiskers. He's gone!
Theo: Whiskers was in my pocket a minute ago.
Now he's disappeared!
Riley: He couldn't have gone very far.
Skyler: He must be close by.
Kids: Here, Whiskers! Come on, Whiskers!
Sarah: I'll look under the couch.
Ben: I'll look behind the chair.
Theo: Maybe Snooks can help us find Whiskers.
Skyler: That's right. Snooks is a hound dog.
He has a good nose for smelling!
Sarah: Come on, Snooks. Find Whiskers!
Snooks: Ah-choo!
Riley: Dust makes Snooks sneeze.
Then his nose gets stuffed up.
Snooks: Ah-choo!
Skyler: Look what I found on the kitchen floor.
Skyler: A cookie! With a bite out of it.
Theo: I bet Whiskers did that.
He loves cookies!
Riley: Aha! That means Whiskers is nearby.
Riley: Uh-oh. We forgot to put the lid on Sammy's cage.
Kelli: It's a good thing that snake didn't get out!
Riley: That's not what I'm worried about.
Theo: What do you mean?
Riley: I . . . uh . . . Well . . . I was wondering.
Riley: Do snakes ever eat hamsters?
Ben: They might if . . .
Theo: If what?
Ben: If they got the chance.
Once Sammy got loose and ate a mouse.
Skyler: So if Sammy could eat a mouse…
Theo: He could eat a hamster!
Sarah: That means . . .
Skyler: Sammy ate Whiskers for dessert!
Kelli: I can't believe that snake ate a hamster!
Theo: It's not just any hamster. It's Whiskers!
Sarah: Bad snake!
Riley: It's not Sammy's fault.
He didn't know any better.
Theo: It's my fault!
I should have watched Whiskers better.
Theo: Now he's gone forever!
Sarah: He was so cute.
Riley: I liked the way he nibbled cookies.
Skyler: And the way he curled up in a ball and rolled.
Theo: He used to curl up with me at night too.
I miss him!
Kelli: Maybe you can get a new hamster for Christmas.
Theo: I don't want a new hamster.
I want Whiskers.
Snooks: Ar-ooo!
Riley: Snooks feels bad too.
Theo: Now Whiskers will never know how much I loved him.
Riley: What is it, Snooks?
Theo: Look, it's Whiskers!
Skyler: Curled up beside Sammy!
Riley: Sammy didn't eat Whiskers after all!
Skyler: And now they're friends!
Ben: Thank you, Sammy, for not eating Whiskers.
Theo: Look, Whiskers wiggled his nose.
Skyler: He's saying thank you to Sammy too.
Riley: For being his best friend!
Theo: Whiskers, you're the best hamster ever.
Riley: And the Pet Lovers Club is the best club in the world!
Riley: This is the perfect place for our Pet Lovers Club meeting.
Sarah: I love going to the pet shop.
Chatter: Happy Birthday!
Skyler: Quiet, Chatter. It's no one's birthday.
Ben: Actually it is someone's birthday.
Look at the sign.
Ben: Saturday is the pet shop's tenth birthday.
Riley: And they're having a party to celebrate!
Ben: Kids can work together in teams.
Ben: Each team brings in ten things about birthdays or pets.
Riley: And everyone gets a prize!
The Pet Lovers Club can do it together!
Kids: Great idea, Riley!
Sarah: There are five of us so . . .
Ben: If we each bring two things, that makes ten.
Theo: My sister Kelli knows how to make frog cupcakes.
Theo: I can bring two of those.
Sarah: I can bring two Happy Birthday balloons.
Chatter: Ha-ha-ha. Happy Birthday!
Skyler: Stop showing off, Chatter.
Ben: I have socks with turtles on them.
Skyler: I can bring two pots of flowers.
Theo: What do flowers have to do with pets?
Skyler: At the pet shop I saw a sign.
Skyler: It says, "We Help Kids Bloom into Pet Lovers."
Theo: Oh, I get it now.
Riley: I don't know what to bring.
Theo: You could bring Snooks.
Snooks: Ar-ooo!
Skyler: But you have only one dog.
We each need to bring two things.
Riley: I know! I'll bring my two guppies, Goldie and Goofy!
Theo: I can't wait until Saturday!
The pet shop party is going to be fun!
Riley: Is everyone ready for the pet store party?
Sarah: I have my Happy Birthday balloons.
Skyler: Here are my two flowerpots.
Ben: I brought my two turtle socks!
Riley: I'll carry Goldie and Goofy in my bag.
Riley: They will be surprised to see the pet store again!
Skyler: But where's Theo?
Theo: Here I am.
I brought two frog cupcakes.
Theo: And my big sister.
Kelli: I'll walk to the pet shop with you.
Mrs. Summers: Thank you, Kelli.
Good luck, everybody.
Kelli: Can you kids hurry?
I'm supposed to meet Curtis at the pet shop.
Theo: Ha-ha! Curtis is your boyfriend!
Kelli: Be quiet, Theo.
Riley: I'm so excited.
We have ten great things!
Skyler: And we each get to pick out a prize.
Ben: Maybe I'll get Speedy some turtle food.
Sarah: I hope they have kitten stickers.
Riley: I'd like to get a bone for Snooks.
Snooks: Ar-ooo!
Riley: Snooks, hurry up!
Snooks likes to stop and sniff.
Skyler: These flowerpots are heavy.
I think I'll sit down.
Ben: Snooks is sniffing Skyler's flowers!
Riley: Snooks, stop!
Skyler: Oh no, Snooks ruined all my flowers!
Riley: Oh, Snooks! Look what you've done!
Snooks: Ar-ooo!
Ben: Now we only have eight things for the party!
Skyler: And it's the pet store's tenth birthday!
Riley: Oh dear. What should we do?
Skyler: Maybe we'd better go back home.
Kelli: No way! I'm meeting Curtis at the pet shop!
Ben: We can still have fun at the birthday party.
Sarah: Even if we only have eight things.
Riley: Besides, I made a promise to Goldie and Goofy.
Ben: What did you promise?
Riley: That they could go to the pet shop!
Theo: We're almost there.
Sarah: I hope we can still get prizes.
Skyler: What's wrong, Ben?
Ben: I can't find my socks.
I had them in my jacket pocket.
Ben: Now they're gone!
Kelli: Will you kids hurry up?
Sarah: But we can't go without Ben's socks.
Riley: Snooks is gone too.
Sarah: There he is!
Ben: Hey, he's got my socks.
Kids: Snooks! Snooks, come back!
Sarah: Snooks chewed up Ben's socks.
Riley: Snooks, you are usually a good boy.
But today you are bad!
Snooks: Woof! Woof!
Theo: Snooks has a new friend.
Kelli: Oh! What a cute kitty!
Ben: Look, the other dog is eating the cupcakes!
Kelli: Hey, I made those cupcakes!
Riley: I can't believe it.
The cupcakes are gone.
Ben: My turtle socks are ruined.
Skyler: And Snooks dug up the flowers.
Riley: This is the worst day of my life!
